UserAccountProfile.title: UserAccountProfile
UserAccountProfile.description: A user account profile created via Google Sign-In storing per-user preferences and workspace metadata.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display name for the user's account workspace.

defaultFormat.description: Preferred default MTG format for new deck imports.

defaultGoal.description: Preferred default Commander Bracket or optimization goal.

lastActiveDeckName.description: Name of the most recently analyzed deck in this user's account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was last updated.

UserDeck.title: UserDeck
UserDeck.description: A user-owned Magic: The Gathering uploaded decklist, analysis summary, and optimized export isolated per user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who uploaded, analyzed, and exported this deck.

deckName.description: Display name of the analyzed deck.

resultingLandCount.description: Resulting land count in the exported list.

totalMainCount.description: Resulting total maindeck + commander card count.

averageCmcNonLand.description: Average mana value of non-land cards.

tappedLandCount.description: Number of lands that likely enter tapped.

activeColorSummary.description: Summary of active mana colors and sources (e.g. U:18 · B:16).

activeChangeCount.description: Count of active swaps, cuts, additions, and land changes applied.

verdictHeadline.description: Headline verdict from the deck analyzer.

isAutoSaved.description: Whether this version was auto-saved upon analysis or manually saved/exported.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the deck version was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the deck version was last updated.

BotLearningMemory.title: BotLearningMemory
BotLearningMemory.description: Per-user adaptive intelligence memory for an AI Playtest Bot tracking faced decks, piloted decks, user coaching feedback, and evolved tactical directives.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

botKey.description: Stable identifier slug for this bot persona/archetype.

botName.description: Display name of the AI playtest bot.

archetype.description: Archetype or custom decklabel piloted by this bot.

matchesPlayed.description: Total simulated matches this bot has learned from.

wins.description: Matches where this bot pressured or defeated the player.

losses.description: Matches where the player overcame this bot.

botIqScore.description: Adaptive Bot IQ rating reflecting accumulated tactical experience and coaching.

lastDeckFaced.description: Most recent player deck fingerprint faced by this bot.

lastOwnDeckSummary.description: Summary of the most recent decklist or archetype piloted by this bot.

learnedFromFacedDecks.description: Bounded list (max 15) of counterplay lessons learned from player decks faced.

learnedFromOwnDecks.description: Bounded list (max 15) of sequencing/mana lessons learned from decks this bot piloted.

userFeedbackNotes.description: Bounded list (max 15) of explicit user coaching notes and ratings.

tacticalDirectives.description: Bounded list (max 15) of active tactical priorities fed into future simulations.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this bot memory profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this bot memory profile was last updated.

/userProfiles/{userId}.description: Per-user account profiles created when a user registers or signs in with Google.

/userDecks/{deckId}.description: Per-user uploaded, analyzed, and exported MTG decks strictly isolated to the authenticated ownerId.

/botMemory/{memoryId}.description: Per-user adaptive AI bot learning profiles isolated to the authenticated ownerId.
